_note: Inputs for physical upper-bound calculations. All flows in cubic feet per second (cfs); areas in acres; yields in kg N per hectare per year. Values are transcribed from the cited public documents.

raccoon_van_meter.label: Raccoon River at Van Meter (USGS 05484500), upstream of Central Iowa Water Works Fleur Drive intake
raccoon_van_meter.source: USGS Water Resources Data Iowa WY2004 (WDR-IA-04-1), station page; https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/eot2008/20080924190628/http:/pubs.usgs.gov/wdr/2004/wdr-ia-04-1/pdf/ia_21.pdf
raccoon_van_meter.yield_source: Schilling KE, Zhang Y-K (2004) Baseflow contribution to nitrate-nitrogen export from a large, agricultural watershed, USA. J Hydrol 295:305-316. doi:10.1016/j.jhydrol.2004.03.010

missouri_omaha.label: Missouri River at Omaha (USGS 06610000), adjacent to Council Bluffs Water Works intake

cedar_cedar_rapids.label: Cedar River at Cedar Rapids (USGS 05464500), recharge source for Cedar Rapids alluvial collector wells
cedar_cedar_rapids.source: USGS Water Resources Data Iowa WY2004; https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/eot2008/20080924190628/http:/pubs.usgs.gov/wdr/2004/wdr-ia-04-1/pdf/ia_15.pdf

export_scenarios_kg_ha_yr._basis: 26.1 = observed long-run Raccoon watershed yield (Schilling & Zhang 2004). 100 and 250 are deliberately extreme ceilings (about 4x and 10x the agricultural watershed yield) chosen to bound, not estimate, construction-phase losses; 5 represents a low-input developed/turf landscape. Results are reported per 1,000 acres so other assumptions can be substituted linearly.

raccoon_documented_central_iowa.components: Microsoft Mountain 41.8 + Alluvion 154 + Osmium 240 + Ginger West 188 + Ginger East 147 + Apple Waukee phase 1 300
raccoon_documented_central_iowa.assumption: conservatively assumes every documented central Iowa campus drains to the Raccoon River above the Fleur Drive intake; several sites likely drain elsewhere

raccoon_with_full_apple_site.components: as above but full ~2,000-acre Apple site

missouri_google_documented.assumption: campus 1 acreage not documented; 140 acres taken from the 1-gemini table as a placeholder for the bound only
